PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

APP_ENV.description: App env for part-db. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

APP_SECRET.description: Generated app secret. Keep private and preserve with backups.

DATABASE_URL.description: SQLite database on the persistent /data volume. Back up together with uploaded files.

DEFAULT_LANG.description: Default lang for part-db. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

USE_GRAVATAR.description: Use gravatar for part-db. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

BASE_CURRENCY.description: Choose the accounting currency before first boot; changing this does not convert stored prices.

DB_AUTOMIGRATE.description: Db automigrate for part-db. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Trusted proxies for part-db. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DEFAULT_TIMEZONE.description: Default timezone for part-db. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

ALLOW_ATTACHMENT_DOWNLOADS.description: Allow attachment downloads for part-db. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DATABASE_SQLITE_ENFORCE_FOREIGN_KEYS.description: Database sqlite enforce foreign keys for part-db. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

INITIAL_ADMIN_PW.description: Generated initial administrator password; used only by the first database migration. Change it in the app after setup.
